text:
mika: Hey team, seeing a bunch of ArgoCD sync failures for eu-west-1 app-of-apps since ~08:10 UTC :warning:
sam: yep noticed, sync backoff + prune waves piling up, some apps stuck in OutOfSync
olivia: error in ArgoCD UI shows 504 when hitting our git webhook endpoint
zhou: any infra churn around 08:00? I can check VPC routes/security groups
mika: I pushed a Terraform change to remove the NAT gateway in eu-west to save costs (replace with shared egress via transit), plan looked fine locally but applied at 07:58
sam: ah ok. that would block outbound to our git host if transit config not ready. can you paste the TF diff?
mika: sure — snippet:
```
# before
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "eu_west_nat" {
  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat_eip.id
  subnet_id     = aws_subnet.public_subnet.id
}

# after
# nat gateway removed, relying on transit gateway route
```

olivia: that matches. ArgoCD agent pods in the cluster need egress to github-repo-host; with NAT gone, requests time out -> 504s
zhou: also seeing weird autoscaler behavior: some GPU nodes launched in us-east-1 by mistake (weird tag mismatch), so cost spike and wrong-region capacity for pods expecting eu-west GPUs
amika: (typo) mika: yes I think nodepool terraform had an interpolation bug, created a us-east nodepool name for our eu-west cluster. I only noticed after nodes came up
infra-bot: Deploy event: terraform apply by mika at 2026-03-18T07:58:12Z
sam: immediate mitigation: revert the NAT removal and pin nodepool region/name. who can do the revert?
mika: I can revert the TF NAT change now and run apply, but I want someone to hold on the nodepool change — looks like it was in the same PR but separate resource.
zhou: I will open a hotfix PR to correct the nodepool name/region mapping and add a unit test for interpolation. will not apply until NAT is back
olivia: +1 from me. once NAT is back, ArgoCD should recover and finish prune waves, then we can cordon & drain the accidental us-east GPU nodes and terminate the nodepool
sam: estimate: NAT revert apply ~5-8m, then ArgoCD agent rechecks. can someone watch the prune queue? I'll keep an eye on costs for those us-east GPUs.
mika: starting revert now. will post when apply completes
infra-bot: terraform plan output: 4 to add, 2 to change, 5 to destroy (by mika)
mika: apply finished 08:05 UTC — NAT gateway recreated, routes restored
olivia: ArgoCD shows agents reconnected, first app syncs succeeding now :tada:
zhou: opening PR for nodepool fix; will request review from sam and mika, will not apply until post-mitigation window
sam: action items: 1) ola (olivia) confirm ArgoCD fully back and prune queue cleared 2) zhou open PR + tests 3) mika follow up on why PRs with multi-resource edits slipped past local plan checks 4) add CI check to detect cross-region nodepool names
olivia: confirmed prune queue dropping, most apps green, a couple of long-running helm jobs still reconciling but progressing
mika: sorry folks — will add more safeguards. learning: no cost savings faster than validated infra routing.
sam: no blame, just guardrails. once zhou's PR merges we should run a dry-run and then schedule nodepool removal during quiet window.
olivia: tagging #postmortems for follow-up doc and cost impact breakdown
zhou: thanks. I'll include the terraform diff and a small script to validate region tags before apply.
infra-bot: Incident closed by sam at 2026-03-18T08:10:30Z
